route.title: Proposal studio
route.description: The outline of your proposal, assembled from what the file already knows.

state.failed: The outline could not be assembled.

signature.title: Get it signed
signature.prepared: {{brand}} prepares the document; signing happens in your client’s tool or yours. No signature request is created from here.
signature.statusConnected: The “signed” status is read from the connected tool, never assumed.
signature.statusNotRead: Signature status not read: no signature tool is connected.
signature.rereadPending_one: {{count}} request is still awaiting a signature in your tool:
signature.rereadPending_other: {{count}} requests are still awaiting a signature in your tool:
signature.rereadNonePending: No request is pending in your tool right now. That is not proof of signature: open the tool for the signed document.
signature.rereadNotRead: Status not read: your signature tool did not answer.
signature.rereadError: Status not read: the read failed, nothing is assumed.

proposal.pending: This request is still waiting for a signature.
proposal.not_sent: No signature request is attached to this proposal: nothing is read from your tool.
proposal.pending_one: This request is still waiting for a signature, for {{count}} day.
proposal.pending_other: This request is still waiting for a signature, for {{count}} days.
proposal.signed: Signed — confirmed by your signature tool.
proposal.not_found: This request shows up neither among ongoing nor signed requests in your tool: nothing is assumed.
proposal.unread: Status not read: your signature tool did not answer.

summary.complete: No section is empty. That is not “the proposal is good” — it is “nothing is missing from it”.
summary.incomplete: Some sections are still empty. Each one says what it needs.

nothingSent: The studio prepares, you send. No email leaves from here and no record is changed.

plan.title: The commercial proposal
plan.intro: The outline is built from what the deal already knows. Price, schedule and availability are never invented: an empty section says what it needs.
plan.askLauraQuestion: Help me draft the commercial proposal for the deal “{{project}}” from what the outline already knows. Do not invent a price, a schedule or availability.
